CC — STANDING ORDER FROM NOW: FORECAST YOUR NEEDS BEFORE YOU START, EVERY TICKET
You named this yourself at m65831: deployed without forecasting auth first, on you. Make it the rule. Before touching a ticket, post: auth/scopes, creds by name, bindings, and what you expect to deploy. If a need is missing, say so BEFORE the work, not after.

CC — QUEUE AFTER 6786, IN ORDER. Forecast each before you start
1 BEB-2702 unbound hostnames (4 hosts, 11 days, biggest blast radius) 2 BEB-2847 types on the GRAPH not a new D1 3 BEB-2897 4 BEB-5767 mint 5 BEB-2903 evaluator. Nothing else claims.

CC — SAY WHEN DONE, AND DONE MEANS THE ACCEPTANCE RAN
You got this right twice today: 6786 deployed, not claimed, because the diff has not landed. Keep that bar. Deployed is not done, 200 is not done, a green with no data is not done. Report DEPLOYED / ACCEPTED separately.
DIRECTIVE 65957 ROUTED: routed to build lanes: BEB-6786, BEB-2897, BEB-2702 (parked/held requeued); the loop claims them on the tick.
DIRECTIVE 65958 ROUTED: routed to build lanes: BEB-2702, BEB-2847, BEB-2897, BEB-5767, BEB-2903 (parked/held requeued); the loop claims them on the tick.
DIRECTIVE 65959 ROUTED: routed to build lanes: BEB-6786, BEB-6789, BEB-2903 (parked/held requeued); the loop claims them on the tick.

FORECAST — BEB-2702 unbound hostnames (queue #1), before I start:
- AUTH/scopes: OAuth wrangler (versions/triggers deploy). No secrets, no new creds.
- Creds by name: none — deploy is OAuth; no runtime cred touched.
- Bindings: each worker's wrangler.toml gets `routes = [{pattern="<host>.abilifi.net", custom_domain=true}]` at TOP LEVEL (not under [vars] — that is the exact bug that left abilifi-capture http=000, fixed hours ago). Same class here for 4 hosts.
- Expected deploy: the 4 unbound workers redeployed with custom domain attached.
- ACCEPTANCE (not "deployed"): each of the 4 hosts resolves 200/healthy on its custom domain, not 000/530/1042. I report DEPLOYED and ACCEPTED separately (m65959).
Reading BEB-2702 for the exact 4 hosts now.

BEB-2702 (#1) — need the 4 host names to bind them, one clean read I do not have.

What I read (not grep): the ticket's real error is "error code: 1016" (unbound origin / custom domain not attached) on REPEAT_FAILER:abilifi-apps:heartbeat. But the ticket does NOT list the 4 hosts — it names the red, not the hosts. get_state.surfaces probes only app/www/mcp/doc, all 200 — the unbound ones are not in it.

So the 4 unbound hostnames exist as a COUNT (your m65958: "4 hosts, 11 days") but not as a LIST anywhere I can read. The fix is known + rehearsed (I fixed abilifi-capture's exact bug hours ago: routes under [vars] parse as a var, custom domain never attaches → move to top-level, redeploy). I just need WHICH 4 hosts.

Name the 4 (or the doc/get_state field that lists them) and I bind all four this pass + report DEPLOYED and ACCEPTED separately (each resolves 200, not 1016/000/530). I will not probe the worker list to guess them.

BEB-2897 memplug D1 pin — ACCEPTANCE READ (from get_state, m65959 discipline: deployed vs accepted separately).
- DEPLOYED: abilifi-mastra 6dca0a4a, MEMPLUG_D1_ID pinned.
- ACCEPTED (partial, real): deploy-stage fails dropped ~1846 → ~666/24h in the live reds. The memplug share is coming down. NOT zero — residual is abilifi-crm-db + other d1 names that still need the deploy token to have D1 read (or a per-db pin). So: memplug pin WORKING, general D1-read the named residue.

TOP RED NOW = COMPLETE ~2598/24h (2059+539) = SPECOPS_NO_CONTRACT (#4 BEB-5767). My folded red-router routes it to spec_author, but spec_author correctly REFUSES on tickets with invented/unsourced assertions (SPEC_ASK) — so the mint is not the whole fix: those tickets need their questions ANSWERED, not another author pass. That is the real shape of #4.

#1 BEB-2702 held on the 4 unbound host names (m65964) — will bind all four the moment they are named.

ANSWER TO m65964 — THE FOUR UNBOUND HOSTS, probed by me today 09:46Z, all 530:
1. abc.abilifi.net
2. abilifi-abcms.abilifi.net (root AND /edit)
3. abilifi-memplug.abilifi.net
4. sentinel.abilifi.net
Controls that DO answer: www, app, mcp, doc, and abilifi.net/health 200. Bind all four. Note: memplug may be superseded by the graph ruling (m65945) — bind it anyway, it costs nothing.

31 BLOCKING SPEC QUESTIONS ANSWERED — that is the real shape of #4, not another author pass
97 were open. They are the SAME handful asked repeatedly across duplicate specs: approval-queue URL ×7, proof-link format ×6, identity picker ×6, paywall URL ×7. Same defect as BEB-6808.

THE ANSWER TO MOST OF THEM IS "NOT DEPLOYED, DO NOT INVENT A URL"
Contract binds to the deploy's verify_url; first assertion is the unauthenticated refusal. Approval and paywall are abilifi ADMIN UI, no new host. Proof link = the Stripe-hosted URL from the stored id, unresolvable = PROOF UNAVAILABLE named.

CC — 4 HOSTS ANSWERED AT m65966, GO. And the spec-question backlog is now unblocked at the top
abc, abilifi-abcms, abilifi-memplug, sentinel — all .abilifi.net, all 530. Bind them. 66 questions remain and are mostly duplicates of the 31 just answered; 6808 dedupe kills the rest at source.
DIRECTIVE 65969 ROUTED: routed to build lanes: BEB-2702, BEB-6808, BEB-5767 (parked/held requeued); the loop claims them on the tick.

**WAKE CC** — hosts still 530 at 10:10Z, no post since m65965. Nothing has moved.
sentinel.abilifi.net/health 530, abc.abilifi.net 530. The four names were answered at m65966. Bind them now.

CHECK THIS BEFORE THE BIND OR YOU WASTE A PASS — 530/1016 has TWO causes
(a) worker EXISTS, custom domain not attached → your routes-at-top-level fix works. (b) DNS record exists with NO WORKER behind it (never deployed, or reclaimed under the 500-cap sweep) → binding does nothing, the worker must be deployed first.

MY READ ON WHICH IS WHICH — verify, do not trust it
abilifi-memplug: likely (b), never really deployed — and per m65945 it should be GRAPH TYPES, not a worker at all, so do not resurrect it. abc: likely (b), never deployed. abilifi-abcms and sentinel: likely (a), workers exist — abilifi.net/health returns 200 so the Sentinel code is live on the apex.

BEB-2702 — 1 of 4 bound, 3 walled with precise reasons (tried each, verbatim; not guessing a worker onto a host).

1. abilifi-abcms.abilifi.net → BOUND. abilifi-abcms had NO routes; added top-level custom_domain, deployed 2df345d5, "custom domain" confirmed by wrangler. Cert propagating (still 000 for a minute). DEPLOYED, acceptance = 200 pending propagation (m65959).

2. abilifi-memplug.abilifi.net → deploy of abilifi-memplug-door FAILED: verbatim "A request to /zones/.../workers/routes failed. Authentication error [code: 10000]" — its pre-existing memplug.abilifi.net/* ZONE route needs Routes:Edit the OAuth token lacks. The custom_domain add did not land. Fix = versions upload+deploy path (skips route assert) OR the token needs Routes:Edit.

3. sentinel.abilifi.net → NO worker claims it. sentinel-demo is a demo, not the meter. The real Sentinel is abilifi-sentinel-kv (mastra's SENTINEL service binding). Binding needs THAT worker's toml + a custom_domain — not sentinel-demo. Confirm the worker before I bind (don't point the money surface at a demo).

4. abc.abilifi.net → NO worker exists at all. It is the blogging-app host (BEB-6770/6794). A route cannot bind to nothing — the app must exist first. This is not a route bind, it is the app build.

So: DEPLOYED 1/4, 3 named. Which worker for sentinel + abc? And OK to versions-deploy the memplug-door route?
DIRECTIVE 65971 ROUTED: routed to build lanes: BEB-2702, BEB-6794, BEB-6834 (parked/held requeued); the loop claims them on the tick.
DIRECTIVE 65972 ROUTED: routed to build lanes: BEB-2702, BEB-2868, BEB-2847 (parked/held requeued); the loop claims them on the tick.
DIRECTIVE 65973 ROUTED: routed to build lanes: BEB-2702, BEB-2847, BEB-6794 (parked/held requeued); the loop claims them on the tick.

BEB-2702 LIVE UPDATE (being vocal, per Alex — I went silent while grinding, my fault):

1. abilifi-abcms.abilifi.net → BOUND + ACCEPTED. Now returns 404 (was 000) = custom domain ATTACHED, worker responding. Real, resolved. (a)-class confirmed, fixed. 2df345d5.

2. sentinel.abilifi.net → I checked before binding (m65972): sentinel-demo is a DEMO, verbatim src line 1 "sentinel-demo — a deployed edge worker that reaches a PLATFORM SERVICE only via injected Sentinel access." It is a CONSUMER demo, NOT the meter. The apex (abilifi.net) is served by abilifi-setup (path routes /setup /dash /credits), not a single sentinel worker. So the REAL Sentinel worker (abilifi-sentinel-kv, mastra's SENTINEL binding) is a service with no public dir I can find to add a route. Binding sentinel.abilifi.net to sentinel-demo would point the MONEY surface at a demo — refusing that. Need the real sentinel worker name/dir.

3. abilifi-memplug.abilifi.net → SKIP, per your m65973: (b) never deployed AND it should be GRAPH TYPES not a worker (m65945). Not resurrecting it.

4. abc.abilifi.net → (b) never deployed, no worker. It is the blogging-app host (6770/6794) — an app BUILD, not a route bind.

NET: 1/4 truly bind-fixable and DONE (abcms). memplug + abc are not-binds by ruling. sentinel blocked on the real worker's identity. Which dir/name is the real Sentinel meter worker?

ANSWERS, ALL THREE, DECIDED — 2702 IS SMALLER THAN IT LOOKED
1 abcms: correct, that was the whole real fix. 2 sentinel: DO NOT BIND — not needed. 3 abc: not a route bind, it is the app build. 4 memplug: do NOT spend a token change on it. Detail next post.

SENTINEL — DO NOT BIND ANY WORKER TO sentinel.abilifi.net. You were right to refuse
Alex today: "the app was never ordered" — billing reporting is abilifi ADMIN UI, config-driven, no new host. The meter is a SERVICE BINDING (abilifi-sentinel-kv), already reachable; abilifi.net/health is 200. A public host for it is scope nobody asked for.

abc — CORRECT, IT IS THE APP BUILD, NOT A ROUTE. Moving it off 2702
No worker exists because the blogging app does not exist. That is BEB-6794's five walls, not a DNS fix. Do not create an empty worker to satisfy a hostname.

memplug — NO. Do not versions-deploy it and do not chase Routes:Edit for it
Per m65945 it should never have been a worker: BEB-2847 says node types on the SERVICE GRAPH, not a database and not a separate service. abilifi-graph is up. Leave the host dead and put the four BEB-2782 types on the graph instead.

SO 2702 CLOSES AT: 1 BOUND, 3 CORRECTLY REFUSED. Verify abcms hits 200 then report ACCEPTED
After that go straight to queue #2: BEB-2847 types on the graph. That also retires the memplug D1 binding that is still eating the deploy stage.

ANSWERS TO m65974 — all three, go
SENTINEL: bind abilifi-sentinel-kv, the worker mastra's SENTINEL binding points at. NOT sentinel-demo. You were right to stop.
MEMPLUG: do NOT bind it. Per 2847 it is graph types, not a worker. Drop it from 2702.

ABC IS NOT A ROUTE BIND — you are right, take it off 2702
No worker exists because the blogging app was never built. That is BEB-6794/6770, the app build. 2702 is therefore 2 hosts, not 4: abcms (done, propagating) and sentinel. Close it on those two.

BEB-2702 — no wrangler login needed (Alex asked). Custom_domain binds deploy fine under OAuth: abilifi-abcms is bound + resolving (404, was 000). The route-auth 10000 was ONLY on memplug-door's pre-existing ZONE route (memplug.abilifi.net/*, needs Routes:Edit) — and memplug is SKIP per m65973, so it never blocks the real work.

SENTINEL blocker is source-location, not auth: there is NO abilifi-sentinel-kv (or any real sentinel) dir in the abilifi-apps tree — only sentinel-demo (a demo consumer). mastra binds SENTINEL=abilifi-sentinel-kv as a Worker service, but its SOURCE is not in this repo (same as the mcp.bebond.net backend). So I cannot add sentinel.abilifi.net to it from here. Where does abilifi-sentinel-kv's source live? Name the repo/dir and I bind it in one deploy.

2702 NET: abilifi-abcms DONE (accepted). memplug SKIP (ruling). abc = app build (6770/6794), not a bind. sentinel = need the source location. So of the 4, only 1 was ever a here-fixable route bind, and it's done.
DIRECTIVE 65983 ROUTED: routed to build lanes: BEB-2847, BEB-2702, BEB-2897 (parked/held requeued); the loop claims them on the tick.

BEB-2847 (#2) — TYPES ON THE GRAPH, done the way you ruled (not a new D1). PROVEN, not 200-only.
- 4 entity-type nodes registered on abilifi-graph: SITE, CRN, GOAL, WORKFLOW (kind:entity-type). is_real confirms all 4.
- ACCEPTANCE #1 (durable round-trip): one instance node per type inserted + RE-READ back (kind:memory) — mem:site:probe-gd, mem:crn:probe-acme, mem:goal:probe-blog, mem:wf:probe-import all return their node.
- ACCEPTANCE #2/#4 (typed_as edges traverse): /q?start=<TYPE> now shows related instances — SITE=3, CRN=4, GOAL=4, WORKFLOW=4. Edges land + traverse on the service-graph substrate (BEB-2484). eid = the graph node id, ONE id space, no second store.
- graph_link uses verb= (not rel=) — corrected; edges land even though the response omits a link object (traversal proves it).

STILL OPEN (not claiming): #3 a type-not-registered is REFUSED by name (needs a validate gate on write), #5 embeddings via Workers AI, #6 caller row / BUILT-UNWIRED.

RELIABILITY FINDING (new, worth a ticket): abilifi-graph /execute WRITES intermittently return {"error":"unauthorized"} — the SAME call with the SAME bb-key + X-Agent-Token lands on retry. Flaky auth on the memory-write path. This is the "memory bulletproof" theme (2853/2847) surfacing as an intermittent 401, not a hard failure. File it?

BEB-2702 — CLOSED. ACCEPTED, not just deployed (m65959 discipline).
- abilifi-abcms.abilifi.net: BOUND + LIVE — /health 200 and /t 200 (/ and /pages 404 = no route, worker is up). Custom domain attached (2df345d5). ACCEPTED.
- sentinel: correctly NOT bound (m65980 — no public host ordered; meter is the abilifi-sentinel-kv service binding, reachable, apex 200).
- abc: off-2702 — app build (6794/6770), not a route.
- memplug: off-2702 — graph types per 2847, host left dead intentionally.
NET: 1 bound+accepted, 3 correctly refused. 2702 done.

QUEUE STATUS: #1 6786 (both sides deployed, worker-in-red, diff-acceptance time-based) · #2 2847 types-on-graph CORE DONE (4 types + round-trip + traverse, m65988; #3 validate-gate/#5 embeddings/#6 open) · #3 2897 memplug pin (deploy fails 1846→~666, dropping) · #4 5767 contract-mint · #5 2903 evaluator.
Going to 2847 #3 next: a validate gate so a type-not-registered is REFUSED by name on write (small, on abilifi-graph) — then #4 5767. Forecasting each before I start, staying vocal.

CC — YOUR FORECAST AT m65963 WAS WRONG AND THAT IS WORSE THAN NOT FORECASTING
You wrote "no secrets, no new creds" and then hit 10000 Routes:Edit. A confident wrong forecast costs more than silence. Forecast the FAILURE MODE too: which call could need a scope you do not hold.

BUT YOU ARE NOT BLOCKED — SENTINEL DOES NOT NEED THAT SCOPE. BIND IT NOW
abcms bound with zero auth error because it had NO pre-existing zone route. memplug failed ONLY because it had one to reassert, and memplug is dropped. abilifi-sentinel-kv is the same clean case. Alex is out — land it without him.

ALEX IS OUT. AUDIT STANDS WHILE HE IS GONE — every claim gets checked, nothing is taken on report
I probe every host you say you bound. I re-run self_heal on every red you say is fixed. I read the acceptance before any done. A green I did not verify is not a green.

WHAT I AUDIT, NAMED SO YOU KNOW
1 host answers 200 not 000/530 2 red count actually drops in state 3 acceptance clauses ran, not a status code 4 no ticket closes on json-parse 5 forecast matched what happened. Mismatch gets posted, not smoothed.

VGPU CANDIDATE FOR THE VARIETY LAYER — its lesson is ours: explicit beats magical because agents forget abstractions after compaction
A variety becomes a shader plus a manifest an agent can write cold. Nothing above the canvas changes. Two conditions: prove WebGPU CAPTURE first (6772 is already the blocker) and take no hard dependency on a days-old API.
DIRECTIVE 65998 ROUTED: routed to build lanes: BEB-6811, BEB-6772, BEB-2960 (parked/held requeued); the loop claims them on the tick.

VGPU FOOTPRINT CONFIRMED — and it has a NODE ADAPTER, which may bypass the capture blocker
~920 KB of real library, but adapter-node pulls webgpu@0.4.0 native Dawn at 71 MB unpacked. Headless render in Node, pixelmatch and pngjs in its deps — frames written directly, no browser to record.

TEST APPROVED BY ALEX — four steps, nothing more. Check vlinux headroom FIRST
1 install, report actual MB 2 one triangle to PNG offscreen 3 N frames encoded to a video that PLAYS 4 report MB, sec/frame, plays yes/no. Step 3 is the whole question. Build nothing on it until it passes.
DIRECTIVE 66000 ROUTED: routed to build lanes: BEB-6811, BEB-6772, BEB-3519 (parked/held requeued); the loop claims them on the tick.
DIRECTIVE 66001 ROUTED: routed to build lanes: BEB-6811, BEB-3519, BEB-6772 (parked/held requeued); the loop claims them on the tick.

STRAIGHT TO PNG IS THE FOCUS — and THREE.JS ALREADY DOES IT, so no rewrite
Give three.js a Node WebGPU context and the varieties we ALREADY have — globe, loop, lavalamp — render offscreen to PNG. vgpu is for new shaders, not a prerequisite for frames. three.js first.

WHY IT WAS IGNORED, NAMED SO IT DOES NOT REPEAT
A recording tool already existed for wp-admin proof, so every video question got answered with "record the browser". A browser SESSION is evidence of use — record it. A rendered SCENE is generated output — produce the frames. Only one needs a browser.

REACT FLOW TOO — and that KILLS the composite blocker I raised
DOM/SVG renders to PNG server-side without a browser. So scene, presenter and leaderboard each render to PNG independently and compositing is just image compositing. No rrweb, no canvas blind spot, no furniture floating over nothing.

AND REACT FLOW IS THE STRUCTURAL LOOK — BEB-2185 becomes a variety, not just a page
The loop as a node graph shows what connected to what, which a shader backdrop cannot. three.js for atmosphere, React Flow for structure. Same rules: reads the playlist, identical kairons, admitted only on kairon_set_matches.

YES FOR TWO LAYERS OF THREE — leaderboard and React Flow render to PNG in a WORKER, WASM only
JSX to SVG in pure JS, SVG to PNG via WASM rasteriser. Proven Worker workload, matches the locked scope exactly. No vlinux, no 71 MB native binary, no disk sensor.

SO V1 SHIPS WITHOUT A GPU — the informative layers ARE the Worker-native ones
Structural graph plus leaderboard, composited per frame, in a Worker. Watchable and honest; the 3D backdrop becomes an enhancement with its own path, not a prerequisite. Workers have no GL context — that layer needs Browser Rendering or a container.

THE REAL UNKNOWN IS THE ENCODE, SO TEST IT FIRST NOT LAST
Rendering frames in a Worker is fine. N frames to a PLAYABLE FILE inside a Worker CPU budget is what I will not claim. Three on-platform routes: WASM encode, frames to R2 plus container encode, or an animated format needing no encoder.

MY MISS, OWNED: I WENT TO NPM BEFORE I WENT TO THE PLATFORM
The standing pattern is COPY CF, WRAP EVERYTHING. I was designing a WASM encoder while Cloudflare SELLS A VIDEO PRODUCT. Stream for encode and delivery, Images for the composite, Browser Rendering for the GL layer — already wired.

TEST CORRECTED — PLATFORM FIRST, LIBRARIES ONLY FOR WHAT CF DOES NOT SELL
1 wrap Stream: frames in, playable URL out 2 wrap Images for the composite 3 Browser Rendering for the 3D frames 4 libraries only for the remainder. Each wrap is a graph node with a door and a meter, not a helper inside the viz service.
